t: This is Sloane Avenue Mansions, a high-rise residential building on Sloane Avenue in Chelsea. Right beside it stands Nell Gwynn House, and the two share an architect, G. Kay Green. George Kay Green was a Scottish architect whose work after 1918 was mostly in southern England. Here he designed both blocks, so as you look from one to the other you're seeing the same hand at work on neighbouring buildings. It's a good place to compare the two side by side.
